text.p: Venezuela's environment minister announced his resignation on Friday, saying his term had run its course.
Roberto Perez Lecuna told a news conference at Miraflores presidential palace he would stay in President Rafael Caldera's Cabinet "only for a little longer."
Perez, environment minister since the start of Caldera's term in February 1994, acknowledged he had been reprimanded by the president for recent comments over a dispute with Colombia.
The minister had accused Colombia of causing environmental damage along their shared border and said: "The best relationship to have with Colombia is not to have any relationship."
